channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: Nvidia reported $115.8 billion of quarterly revenue on 17 November, guided the next quarter to $130 billion with no China data centre revenue assumed, and lifted next year's growth outlook to 75%, saying chips, packaging and memory supply are coming together. Hours later, Loudoun County, the largest data centre market in the world, voted 7-1-1 to stop acting on new data centre and substation rezonings for up to 12 months, backdated to 15 September, with 33 applications in the queue. The day before, PJM asked FERC to cut the study of new data centre load and generation from two years to one, and Texas resumed environmental permits. Silicon is no longer what limits where capacity converts; zoning boards and grid queues are. List prices held for an eighth day: 70 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW, with Lambda H100 at $4.59 and B200 at $7.69.

item.title: Compute brief - 18 November 2026
item.description: Nvidia reported $115.8 billion of quarterly revenue on 17 November, guided the next quarter to $130 billion with no China data centre revenue assumed, and lifted next year's growth outlook to 75%, saying chips, packaging and memory supply are coming together. Hours later, Loudoun County, the largest data centre market in the world, voted 7-1-1 to stop acting on new data centre and substation rezonings for up to 12 months, backdated to 15 September, with 33 applications in the queue. The day before, PJM asked FERC to cut the study of new data centre load and generation from two years to one, and Texas resumed environmental permits. Silicon is no longer what limits where capacity converts; zoning boards and grid queues are. List prices held for an eighth day: 70 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW, with Lambda H100 at $4.59 and B200 at $7.69. Countries: United States: Loudoun County pauses data centre and substation approvals up to 12 months; PJM files a one-year joint study; Nvidia guides $130 billion (Wire, 16 to 17 Nov, confirmed). Singapore: US Justice and Commerce confirm a criminal export-control probe into Megaspeed (Wire, 17 Nov, confirmed). India: Amazon commits $7 billion more to renewables by 2030 and signs 934 MW of PPAs (Wire, 17 Nov, confirmed). Israel: Enlight and Shemen plan up to 150 MW in Haifa; grid application filed (Wire, 16 Nov, confirmed). Australia: Macquarie Data Centres files for 200 MW, AU$2 billion in Macquarie Park, Sydney (Wire, 17 Nov, single-source).
